seo.title: Setu Retail — Cloud POS with GST Billing & Inventory
seo.description: Cloud POS for Indian shops: GST billing that works offline, stock with batches, udhaar, purchases, cash book and branch reports. 3 months free.

hero.headline: The cloud POS for shops, from one counter to a hundred branches
hero.subheadline: GST billing that keeps going when the internet drops, stock with batches and expiry, udhaar, purchases and a cash book — for owners, managers and cashiers. Start with 3 months of Basic free.

features.title: GST billing, even offline
features.text: Fast counter billing with CGST/SGST/IGST and HSN on every receipt. Counters keep billing with no internet and sync when it's back.

features.title: Stock, batches and expiry
features.text: Branch-wise stock, low-stock alerts, batches with expiry picked earliest-first, barcode labels and a full stock register.

features.title: Udhaar and payments
features.text: Credit sales post to the customer ledger; record payments received, oldest dues first, with invoice aging.

features.title: Purchases and suppliers
features.text: Supplier bills that add stock and record input GST, returns to suppliers, payables aging and a cash book per branch.

features.title: Owners, managers, cashiers
features.text: Every person has their own login and role. Cashiers bill; managers run their branches; the owner sees everything, with an audit log.

features.title: Many branches
features.text: Branch prices, stock transfers that are checked on arrival, and branches compared side by side.

plansNote: Prices include GST and are per business. Every plan has every feature; plans differ in how many branches, staff, products, customers and bills a month they hold.

howKeys.headline: How buying works
steps: Sign up in the app and verify your email: you get 3 months of Basic free.
Pick a plan here and pay by UPI, card or net banking (PayPal outside India).
We show and email a license key. Press Redeem in Setu Retail and the days are added after your current plan.

faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes: 3 months of Setu Retail Basic, free, after you verify your email. No card needed.

faq.question: Can I look around before signing up?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the live demo at demo.setu-retail.setutechnology.com and try Setu Retail before you sign up. When you're ready, sign up at app.setu-retail.setutechnology.com for your 3-month free trial.

faq.question: What happens when my plan ends?
faq.answer: The account locks online until a key is redeemed; your data stays. Counters already offline keep billing, and their bills sync once you renew.

faq.question: Can I move to a bigger plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Redeem a key for the new plan and choose to switch now (the days you had left are converted) or to start it when the current plan ends.

faq.question: I use the free Browser Based POS. Can I bring my data?
faq.answer: Yes. Download POS_BACKUP.json from the free POS and import it in Settings → Import & export: products, customers, stock and batches, plus suppliers, purchases, expenses and udhaar history.

faq.question: Do prices include GST?
faq.answer: Yes. Every price shown includes GST, and the invoice we email shows it.

crossSell.text: Just one counter and no need for the cloud? The Browser Based POS is free forever.

sections.title: Built for the minute a customer is waiting
sections.subtitle: The billing screen is the one your cashiers live on, so everything on it is one tap or one scan away — online or not.

items.title: Scan or search
items.text: One box searches name, SKU and barcode. Any USB or Bluetooth scanner that types works, and the item drops into the cart on Enter.

items.title: Hold and recall carts
items.text: Park a cart with a note, serve the next customer, and bring the first one back exactly as it was.

items.title: Discounts with a cap
items.text: Flat or percent on the bill. Cashiers can give up to a cap the owner sets (10% to start); managers and owners any amount.

items.title: Split payments
items.text: Cash, UPI, card or any method you add — and one bill can be paid across more than one of them.

items.title: Keeps billing offline
items.text: Lose the internet and counters keep billing and taking payments. Bills sync on their own when the connection is back.

items.title: No clashing bill numbers
items.text: Every branch and counter has its own series, like B1-C2-00045, so two offline counters never issue the same number.

sections.title: Receipts your accountant will not send back
sections.subtitle: Prices include GST, and every bill carries the split, the HSN and the place of supply.

items.title: CGST, SGST and IGST
items.text: The tax is split by place of supply on every line, with HSN codes and your GSTIN printed on the receipt.

items.title: Thermal and A4
items.text: 80mm and 58mm thermal rolls or plain A4. Print, download a PDF, or share a link on WhatsApp.

items.title: Receipt designs per branch
items.text: Save several designs, pick a default for the business, let each branch choose its own — the cashier can switch when printing.

items.title: Cancels and returns
items.text: Owners and managers cancel or refund a bill; stock goes back and the change is written to the audit log.

sections.title: One product list, stock in every branch
sections.subtitle: Products are shared across the business. Price, stock and batches are kept per branch.

items.title: Branch prices
items.text: Set one default price, and let any branch charge its own. Billing uses the branch price and falls back to the default.

items.title: Batches and expiry
items.text: Track batches with expiry dates. Billing picks the earliest expiry first, or the cashier picks the batch.

items.title: Low-stock alerts
items.text: Every branch sees what is running low or already out, before a customer asks for it.

items.title: Barcode labels
items.text: A4 label sheets, thermal label rolls and single labels — and in-store EAN-13 codes for items that never had one.

items.title: Stock register
items.text: Every opening, sale, purchase, transfer and adjustment is kept with the resulting stock level.

items.title: Import from the free POS
items.text: Bring POS_BACKUP.json from the Browser Based POS: products, customers, stock, batches and your full udhaar history.

sections.title: Remember the regulars, chase what they owe
sections.subtitle: A customer book that fills itself at billing and feeds the ledger, aging and statements.

items.title: Add mid-sale
items.text: A walk-in becomes a saved customer without leaving the billing screen — any role can do it.

items.title: Credit (udhaar) sales
items.text: Bill to a customer's ledger instead of the till. Payments received clear the oldest dues first.

items.title: Invoice aging
items.text: Set credit days for the business or per customer, and see dues as not due, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90 and 90+ days late.

items.title: Purchase history
items.text: Open any customer to see every bill they took, their total spend and what is still outstanding.

sections.title: The books behind the counter
sections.subtitle: All 12 connected tools from the free POS, rebuilt on cloud data and shared by every branch.

items.title: Purchase register
items.text: A supplier bill adds stock to a branch, updates cost price and records input GST per line. Paid, on credit or part-paid.

items.title: Purchase returns
items.text: Send goods back for a credit note that reduces what you owe, or for a replacement you mark when it arrives.

items.title: Supplier ledger & payables aging
items.text: Payments to suppliers clear the oldest bills first, and payables aging shows what is due when.

items.title: Cash book per branch
items.text: Cash sales, refunds, expenses and payments post on their own. A day's opening is the previous day's closing.

items.title: Expense tracker
items.text: Rent, salaries, electricity — recorded per branch, offline too, for owners and managers.

items.title: Profit dashboard
items.text: Net sales before GST, minus cost of goods sold, minus expenses — by branch and by day or month.

sections.title: From one shop to a hundred
sections.subtitle: Built on the same multi-outlet base as Setu Dine, so a chain gets branch reporting from the first day.

items.title: Send, then receive
items.text: Sending takes stock out as in transit. The receiving branch checks the goods; short or damaged lines go back or are written off.

items.title: Batches travel with stock
items.text: Transferred batches keep the same batch number, expiry and cost in the receiving branch.

items.title: Branches side by side
items.text: Sales, bills, average bill, returns, profit, expenses, stock value and udhaar outstanding for every branch.

items.title: Stock across branches
items.text: Each product's stock in every branch, with low in one and spare in another highlighted for a transfer.

items.title: Transfer report
items.text: What moved, what is still in transit and what came up short.

items.title: A branch switcher
items.text: Owners and managers move between their branches in one tap; cashiers stay on the one they work in.

sections.title: Every login is a person, every change is on record
sections.subtitle: Access is checked on the server for every request, so removing someone takes effect at once.

items.title: Own login and counter PIN
items.text: Everyone signs in with email or username and a password, plus a PIN to sign in at the counter offline.

items.title: Shift-length sessions
items.text: A sign-in lasts one 12-hour shift. Five wrong passwords lock that login for 15 minutes.

items.title: Audit log for 2 years
items.text: Sign-ins, staff and roles, prices and stock, cancels, payments, transfers and imports — before and after, filterable, CSV.

items.title: Cashiers see no margins
items.text: Cost price and profit never reach a cashier's device. A different person signing in clears the previous person's copy.

items.title: Nightly backups
items.text: The database is backed up every night and kept for 90 days, on top of your own CSV exports.

items.title: Plan ends, data stays
items.text: If a plan lapses the account locks online until a key is redeemed; nothing is deleted, and offline bills sync once you renew.

roles.title: Owners, managers and cashiers each see their own POS
roles.subtitle: Give every person their own login and role. Managers run one or more branches; cashiers work in exactly one. The menu hides what a role cannot use, and the server refuses it anyway.
